audit_items.proof_trace: The guard at line 804 (`assert!(!asset.flash_loan_ongoing(), ...)`) directly aborts if `flash_loan_lock == true`. `flash_loan_triggered` (sets lock) and `flash_loan_finished` (clears lock) are both `public(package)` with exactly one caller each (market.move:806 and market.move:834). The `FlashLoan` struct has no `drop`/`store`/`key` abilities (hot potato), so it cannot be abandoned — the only destructuring site is `repay_flash_loan`, which calls `flash_loan_finished()` and resets the lock.
